entry.title: Nova Audio 0.2.0
entry.summary: Lets a plugin play the MPC's audio inputs as its own sound, so a hardware synth becomes one ordinary MPC track: played, monitored, recorded, mixed and resampled on the plugin's own track, with no separate audio track and no Monitor switching. Two builds: `-mpc-armv7` for Gen1 devices and `-mpc-aarch64` for Gen2. Both are built for glibc 2.31, so either loads on MPC OS 2.x as well as 3.x. Install the one matching your device; the installer refuses a mismatch. **Tested on Gen1 (MPC Live II, MPC OS
